elements.requirement: Subject to the parliamentary approval requirement for a separate order, when the Secretary of State makes a designation order, the Secretary of State must either establish a housing action trust for the designated area or specify an existing housing action trust established for another designated area as the trust for the designated area, doing so either in that designation order or by a separate order.
elements.quote: where the Secretary of State makes a designation order, he shall, in that order or by a separate order, either— (a) establish a housing action trust for the designated area; or (b) specify as the housing action trust for the designated area a housing action trust already established for another designated area.

elements.requirement: A separate order made by the Secretary of State under subsection (1) must be made by statutory instrument, and it cannot be made unless a draft of the order has been laid before, and approved by a resolution of, each House of Parliament.
elements.quote: Such a separate order as is referred to in subsection (1) above shall be made by statutory instrument but no such order shall be made unless a draft of it has been laid before, and approved by a resolution of, each House of Parliament.

elements.requirement: Subject to any name alteration made under subsection (4), a housing action trust is a body corporate bearing the name prescribed by the order that establishes it.
elements.quote: a housing action trust shall be a body corporate by such name as may be prescribed by the order establishing it.

elements.requirement: Where the Secretary of State specifies an already established housing action trust for a designated area, that trust is treated by virtue of the order as established for the new designated area as well as for any designated area for which it is already established.
elements.quote: the housing action trust specified in the order shall, by virtue of the order, be treated as established for the new designated area (as well as for any designated area for which it is already established)

elements.requirement: Where the Secretary of State specifies an already established housing action trust for a designated area, the order may alter the trust's name to reflect the addition of the new designated area.
elements.quote: the order may alter the name of the trust to take account of the addition of the new designated area.

elements.requirement: Schedule 7 to the Housing Act 1988 has effect regarding the constitution of housing action trusts, and Schedule 8 has effect regarding their finances.
elements.quote: Schedule 7 to this Act shall have effect with respect to the constitution of housing action trusts and Schedule 8 to this Act shall have effect with respect to their finances.

elements.requirement: A housing action trust must not be regarded as a servant or agent of the Crown or as enjoying any Crown status, immunity, or privilege.
elements.quote: a housing action trust is not to be regarded as the servant or agent of the Crown or as enjoying any status, immunity or privilege of the Crown

elements.requirement: Property belonging to a housing action trust must not be regarded as property of the Crown or as property held on behalf of the Crown.
elements.quote: the trust’s property is not to be regarded as the property of, or property held on behalf of, the Crown.

elements.requirement: Under section 4 of the Housing Act 1985, 'housing action trust' is defined as a housing action trust established under Part III of the Housing Act 1988.
elements.quote: “housing action trust” means a housing action trust established under Part III of the Housing Act 1988

elements.requirement: Section 14 of the Rent Act 1977 is amended to add a housing action trust established under Part III of the Housing Act 1988.
elements.quote: at the end of section 14 of the Rent Act 1977 (landlord’s interest belonging to local authority etc.) there shall be added— ha housing action trust established under Part III of the Housing Act 1988.
